observations.classification: Existing current ledger row 472; fresh bounded corroboration only, no new count or automatic alias.
observations.first_contract: BuffeDesign independently validates courses and breaths, with no shown cross-field chart membership at this gate. The actual selected burgonet path shortens its top-course chart from 100 mm using upper or lower boundary plus overlap, while openings are placed against the full 100 mm chart. PiercedDomain rejects hole points outside the outer chart or within the minimum web before triangulation.
observations.conditional_reasoning: For otherwise valid inputs, default three courses use upper 700 permille and overlap 5 mm, giving a top chart about 35 mm. The buffe breath preset with height changed to 820 permille has center at 82 mm, 12 mm slot length and zero inclination; its separate scalar and spacing checks pass. Its points fall outside that chart. This is source and arithmetic reasoning: no input was constructed and no fixture, geometry, UI, shader, device or product ran. The recipe validates and creates its kernel before parts dispatch; the later structured VisorOpeningSpacing rejection requires the earlier steps to succeed and the affected selected path to be reached. Actual supported caller, configured GPU/native conditions and presentation are unproved.
observations.safeguards: None for courses or zero/None breaths remains an intentional selected plain face; independent child validators and the later pierced-domain boundary return typed errors for their scopes. The latter prevents this particular out-of-chart hole from proceeding to triangulation when reached; it does not prove all geometry valid.

observations.first_contract: A two-plate BuffeCourses value stores and validates upper_boundary even though its comment says it is used with three faceplates. Editor source always offers the upper seam control once courses exist and labels it three-plate. Host chart indexes lower_boundary for the top of a two-plate design, and the displayed shader-source bounds use lower_boundary for the two relevant course indices while the host stores both values in floats.
observations.conditions_and_limits: A dormant upper seam may intentionally preserve a preset when changing plate count. This observation does not establish rendered output, a supported UI interaction, persistence/hash behavior, all uses of upper_boundary, a defect, or that a variant payload is required. It differs from shortened-chart breath placement and q3141 ring topology; no alias or count is assumed.
observations.future_direction: Clarify the editor/persistence behavior and decide whether the inactive control is an intentional preset or should become variant-owned only after the full consumer and product policy are established.

observations.classification: Selected source-backed safeguard/nonfinding, not a global admission or lens clearance.
observations.first_contract: The ordinary helmet recipe calls HelmetDesign::validate before parts dispatch. HelmetDesign validates an available crown and the Burgonet buffe. Crown validates fullness and ridge and delegates optional fluting; BuffeDesign delegates optional courses and breaths. A successful buffe collection uses one face without courses or a locally validated count of two or three, so the observed three-entry low-bound table covers the selected indices and face.len()-1 is nonempty on that successful path.
observations.conditions_and_limits: The guard depends on entry through the inspected recipe, successful preceding work, and successful collection. The body of other callers or arbitrary direct helper inputs is not exhausted. q3141 asks independently about fan_dome columns and generic paired-ring topology; this packet does not reread that historical source body or prove all native topology. Fluting range/order checks precede end-start and fade*2, bounding these arithmetic operations for accepted earlier operands.
